identity_definitions.verbatim_question_identity: Exact UTF-8 question string equality within the same module. Answer text is not part of this key.
identity_definitions.semantic_identity: Exact equality of the frozen semantic_id within the same module. The semantic_id is SHA-256 of module name, ASCII unit separator, and the exact-rational alpha-normalized polynomial canonical serialization.
identity_definitions.unique_semantic_unit: One distinct interpolate semantic_id within a module.
identity_definitions.train_match: At least one retained train row in the same module has the registered identity.
identity_definitions.no_match: No retained train row in the same module has the registered identity after the complete train census.
identity_definitions.unresolved: Parser, signature, symbolic verifier, row-integrity, or artifact-hash failure. No-match may not be used for an unresolved row.

primary_outputs.overall: Sum numerators and denominators across modules only after reporting both modules separately.
primary_outputs.prevalence_formula: numerator / denominator with exact integer numerator and denominator retained in output
primary_outputs.rounding: Display decimals are secondary; canonical JSON stores integer counts and IEEE-754 division results.

multiplicity_outputs.semantic_id_table_unit: One distinct interpolate semantic_id within one module.
multiplicity_outputs.distribution: For each module, count unique interpolate semantic IDs by the ordered pair (train_multiplicity, interpolate_multiplicity).
multiplicity_outputs.row_weighted_distribution: For each module, count interpolate rows by train_multiplicity.

witness_outputs.evaluation_audit_rows: Exactly 20,000 rows in module then row_index order, including both overlap and no-match decisions.
witness_outputs.semantic_collision_witnesses: One row per semantically overlapping interpolate row.
witness_outputs.semantic_train_witness_selection: Smallest train row_index in the same module with the same semantic_id.
witness_outputs.verbatim_train_witness_selection: Smallest train row_index in the same module with the exact same question, or null.

independent_symbolic_verifier.applies_to: Every semantically overlapping interpolate row and its selected train witness.
independent_symbolic_verifier.parser: Independently parse the registered module prefix and final period using sympy.sympify(..., evaluate=False).
independent_symbolic_verifier.alpha_normalization: Independently map each expression's sorted free symbols to x0, x1, ... .
independent_symbolic_verifier.test: The symbol arities must match and sympy.simplify(sympy.expand(train_normalized - interpolate_normalized)) must equal exact integer zero.
additional_checks: Independently regenerated canonical srepr equals the stored value for both rows.
Independently regenerated semantic_id equals the stored value for both rows.
Selected train witness is the minimum matching train row_index.
independent_symbolic_verifier.failure: Mark the row unresolved and fail the complete census gate.

deterministic_ordering.evaluation_audit_rows: module order polynomials__expand then polynomials__collect, then ascending interpolate row_index
deterministic_ordering.collision_witnesses: module order, then ascending interpolate row_index
deterministic_ordering.jsonl: compact separators with one LF-terminated object per row

required: both train streams have exactly 100000 contiguous rows
both interpolate streams have exactly 10000 contiguous rows
all semantic collision witnesses pass exact symbolic verification
all representative witnesses obey minimum-row-index selection
module-level counts sum exactly to overall counts
independent aggregate recomputation matches released results

allowed_if_pass: Exact train/interpolate verbatim and canonical semantic overlap prevalence for the two regenerated polynomial modules under the pinned seeds.
Every reported semantic collision has an independently verified symbolic-equivalence witness.
forbidden: The released pre-generated Mathematics Dataset files have the same overlap prevalence.
Other Mathematics modules have the same overlap prevalence.
Semantic overlap causes a behavioral performance change.
The result reclassifies external-behavior-v1, CLUTRR, or quality-enhancement-v1 P3.
